childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_image_alt: Uba ko uwa yana rike da jariri yana kallonsa
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Lokacin da aka haifi jarirai, ganinsu yana da rauni. A takaice suna kama da 'makafi'. Amma ganinsu zai ci gaba da bunkasa cikin shekaru 5 zuwa 8 masu zuwa, kuma mafi yawan sauyi yana faruwa a watanni 18 na farko na rayuwa. Wannan lokaci ne mai matukar muhimmanci.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: A wannan lokaci tsarin gani na idanu da kwakwalwa dole ne ya kasance lafiya kuma yana samun motsawa. Wannan ne mafi kyawun lokaci don gano cuta da tura mara lafiya domin magani.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_brain_image_alt: Idanu da hanyoyin gani da ke hade su da kwakwalwa
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Dalilin da yadda muke gano cuta domin kara bunkasa gani sosai
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Duk wata cuta ta ido ko kwakwalwa za ta rage bunkasa kuma ta iyakance gani na dogon lokaci. Shi ya sa yana da muhimmanci a gano da wuri-wuri duk wasu dalilan cuta masu magani da ke shafar bunkasar gani da kuma bunkasar jiki gaba daya.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Ana iya yin hakan ta hanyar tambayar game da gani, ciki, haihuwa, kowace rashin lafiya da kuma bunkasa gaba daya
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Sai a lura da idanu domin tantance bunkasar gani, sannan a yi gwajin fundal 'red' reflex da kuma duba gaban ido domin binciken cututtukan ido
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: A cikin mahaifa, jaririn da ke cikin ciki yana kewaye da sauti mai laushi da kwantar da hankali, ciki har da bugun zuciyar mahaifiyarsu da murya da sauti daga duniyar waje.
Yayin da ciki ya kai matakin ƙarshe, idanun jariri na iya buɗewa a cikin mahaifar.
Yayin da har yanzu ba su iya ganin hotuna ko cikakkun bayanai ba, suna iya ganin canje-canje a cikin haske.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Misalin matakin ciki na jaririn da ba a haifa ba a cikin mahaifa
Misalin matakin ciki na ƙarshen ciki yana nuna wayewar haske
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: A lokacin haihu, hangen nesa ba kamar na manya ba ne. Jariri 'makaho' ne da rashin kyawun gani na kusan 6/600. Ba sa tsinkayar launi da yawa kuma suna da ƙarancin hankali. Ba su da stereovision kuma idanunsu na iya lumshe ido akai-akai.
Duk da haka za su kalli fuska kai tsaye a kusa da kusa, kuma su matse idanunsu zuwa haske mai haske. Tunaninsu daga yanzu zai yi girma da sauri kuma ya zama kamar manya da shekaru 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: A cikin makonni biyu hangen nesa ya inganta sosai. Yanzu suna iya ganin wasu daki-daki, musamman idan abubuwa suna kusa. Babu launi kuma abin da suke gani yana kwance, saboda har yanzu idanunsu ba su miƙe ba kuma suna aiki tare don zurfin fahimta.
Wani lokaci idanunsu za su shuɗe ciki ko waje na ɗan lokaci kaɗan. Ana kiran wannan squinting. Wannan ya kamata a daina faruwa da watanni uku.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_image_: Misalin ci gaban gani na makonni biyu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: A wata daya hangen nesa launi ya fara tasowa. Za su fi sha'awar gani musamman ga fuskoki. Za su kuma fara ƙoƙarin bin abubuwan da ke motsawa.
Za su ƙara sanin sautunan da aka saba da su gami da sanannun muryoyin kamar danginsu. Kuma fara haɗa abin da suka ji da abin da suke gani.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Haɓaka gani tsakanin makonni biyu da wata ɗaya
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Bayan wata uku idanunsu ya kamata su kasance madaidaiciya kuma suyi aiki tare don ƙirƙirar hangen nesa na 3D. Wannan sabon fahimtar zurfin fahimta yana taimaka musu isa ga abubuwa daidai. Za su iya bin abubuwan da ke tafiya da sauri amma yana da wuya a canza gyara daga fuska ɗaya ko abu zuwa wani da sauri.
Suna son kallon abu ɗaya kawai a lokaci guda. Hakanan suna iya fara yin sautinsu na farko masu ma'ana.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Haɓaka gani tsakanin wata ɗaya zuwa uku
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Jariri mai hangen nesa na yau da kullun zai yi farin ciki da ganin kofi ko cokali na sha kuma zai iya gyarawa akai-akai tare da bin fuska a nesa na mita 1-2 tare da iya bambanta tsakanin saba da fuskokin da ba a sani ba ta fuskoki da muryoyinsu.
Hakanan za su iya fara ganin abubuwan da suka fi nisa. Ƙaunar son sani, za su fara isa ga abubuwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: A cikin watanni 6 zuwa 12, ƙarfin gani yana inganta kuma yana kusa da 6/36. Tazarar da ake kallon fuskoki kuma an gane ta ya kai mita 2. Duk abubuwan hangen nesa suna inganta tare da ingantacciyar isarwa da fahimta.

A wannan shekarun suna ƙara sha'awar hotuna a cikin littattafai da talabijin, kodayake abubuwa na ainihi sun fi sha'awar ƙarfafa su don yin rarrafe da kuma kusa da ranar haihuwarsu ta farko, tafiya zuwa abubuwan sha'awa. Babblings suna tasowa, kuma sautuna za su zama kalmomi na farko a wannan zamani kuma.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Da watanni 18, hangen nesa ya zama babba kamar ko da yake har yanzu yana da ɗan ruɗe a yanayin gani na kusan 6/18. Yanzu za su iya gane sunansu kuma suna ƙara amfani da kalmomi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Ci gaban gani tsakanin watanni goma sha biyu zuwa goma sha takwas
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Bayan watanni 18 na shekaru hangen nesa har yanzu yana buƙatar shekaru da yawa don girma. Matsakaicin gani na manya na yau da kullun zai kasance yana da shekaru 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Ci gaban gani tsakanin watanni goma sha takwas zuwa shekaru takwas
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Bayan shekaru 8 tsarin gani bazai inganta da kyau ga jiyya kamar aikin tiyata na cataract ba. Gane cututtuka da kuma neman magani don haka yana da kyau a yi da wuri a farkon rayuwa.

Ana iya ganin cewa babban adadin ci gaba yana faruwa tsakanin haihuwa da watanni 18 kuma yana ci gaba da sannu a hankali a cikin sauran yara. A wannan lokacin yana da mahimmanci cewa yaron yana da lafiya tare da tsarin gani mara lafiya kuma an ba shi yanayi mai ban sha'awa da ilimi.
Gano farkon bayyanar cututtuka tare da neman magani yana da mahimmanci don taimakawa haɓaka haɓakar gani da haɓaka gaba ɗaya.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_image: Bayan shekaru takwas hoton ci gaban gani

i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_account_security:
Idan kun ƙirƙiri asusu, da fatan za a kiyaye bayanan shiga ku cikin tsaro.
Kuna da alhakin ayyuka akan asusunku sai dai idan kun sanar da mu game da rashin amfani ko matsalar tsaro.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: Wannan app kayan aikin ilimi ne don tallafawa koyo da bita. Ba shawara na ilimi ba ne, doka ko ƙwararru kuma ba zai iya ba da garantin fasfo na jarrabawa, maki ko kowane sakamako na musamman ba. Zaɓuɓɓukan karatu da yanke shawara sun kasance alhakin mai amfani.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Wannan bayanan yana taimakawa wajen daidaita ƙa'idar zuwa burin kowane mutum, fahimtar yadda ake amfani da ƙa'idar da haɓaka fasali akan lokaci. Ana iya amfani da shi don tuntuɓar muhimman canje-canje ga ƙa'idar ko asusu.
Ba a taɓa sayar da bayanan sirri ba.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Ana iya buƙatar tabbatar da ainihi kafin a kammala buƙata. Idan duk wani bayani dole ne a adana saboda doka ko dalilai na tsaro, za a bayyana wannan.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Ana tattara bayanan da ake buƙata don gudanar da haɓaka sabis ɗin kawai.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Manufar ita ce kiyaye app ɗin yana taimakawa kuma abin dogaro, amma babu sabis ɗin da ya dace. Ba za a yi alƙawarin ci gaba da kasancewa ko cikakken 'yanci daga kurakurai ba, kuma app ɗin bazai dace da kowane yanayi ba.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Ana adana bayanai a kan uwar garken da aka sarrafa da kuma bayanan da hanyar dogo ta bayar. Railway yana ba da masauki da ababen more rayuwa; muna sarrafa yadda ake amfani da bayanai a cikin ƙa'idar kuma muna adana shi kawai tsawon lokacin da ake buƙata.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Mun dogara ga amintattun sabis na ɓangare na uku, kamar masu ba da sabis, don gudanar da app. Waɗannan sabis ɗin suna aiwatar da bayanai kawai kamar yadda ake buƙata don samar da abubuwan more rayuwa kuma ba su da izinin amfani da shi don dalilai na kansu.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Har zuwa yadda dokar Burtaniya ta ba da izini, ba mu da alhakin asara kamar alamar da aka rasa, asarar samun kudin shiga ko damar da ta taso daga amfani, ko rashin iya amfani da app ɗin. Babu wani abu a nan da ya cire duk wani haƙƙoƙin da dokar Burtaniya ta bayar.

videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_001: Catrat shine mafi yawan sanadin makanta da ake iya magancewa a duniya.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_002: Yana da mahimmanci a iya bincika majiyyaci kuma a tabbatar da abin da ke haifar da catrat da za a iya magance shi.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_003: Fara da tambayar idan guguwar ta kasance a hankali ko kwatsam.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_004: Idan daya ko duka idanu sun shafi, kuma idan akwai wani ciwo ko shiri.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_005: Na gaba, gwada ƙarfin gani don nisa kuma a cikin A.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_006: Yi amfani da rami don tabbatar da rashin gilashin ba shine dalilin ba.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_008: Shin baƙar fata ne, zagaye da daidai?
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_010: Idan kuna da haske mai haske, duba idan ɗalibin ya takura.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_011: A cikin ci gaban cataract, almajiri na iya kama da fari.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_012: Ko da a cikin ido, ya kamata almajiri ya mayar da martani ga haske.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_013: Yi nazarin gaban ido da kyau tare da acolyte ko tare da wasu na'urori.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_014: Bincika don tabbatar da cewa babu wani abu da ke damun ido, musamman tabon cornea.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_015: Tare da acolyte, Hakanan zaka iya bincika rawaya ko reindefundal reflex.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_016: A cikin ido tare da cataract, ana iya samun tabo masu duhu.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_017: Faci ya ɓace ko ba ya nan gaba ɗaya, suna kallo
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_018: duhu ko ma fari a cikin balagagge cataracts.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_019: Idan hangen nesa ba shi da kyau kuma fanroly flex yayi kyau, to ana iya
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_022: Wannan lamari ne musamman idan almajiri bai hana haske sosai ba.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_023: Binciken bayan ido zai taimaka wajen tayar da abin da ba daidai ba.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_024: Ana iya samun matsala tare da jijiyar gani ko retina ko duka biyun.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_025: Jijiya na iya samun babban gibi saboda glaucoma ko kuma a haɗa shi daga
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_028: Ciwon sukari na iya lalata retina, tabo ta hanyar kamuwa da cuta ko kuma yana iya rabuwa.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_029: A wannan yanayin, aikin tiyata na zuciya bazai inganta hangen nesa ba.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_030: A taƙaice, lokacin da ake tantance cataract, ɗauki tarihi, gwada gani, duba
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_031: gaban ido don tabbatar da cataract da kuma ware wasu cututtuka.
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_032: Duba don ganin idan bipus zagaye ne, baki, daidaitacce kuma mai amsawa ga haske, kuma idan
videos_cataract_cataract_identification_.cue_033: iya yin gwajin reflux na fondle da bincika bayan ido.

assessmentVisionPage.cue_001: Wannan bidiyon yana bayyana yadda ake shirya yaro da uwa ko mai kulawa kafin yin gwajin jajircewa a cikin jarirai da manyan yara.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_002: Ya kamata a rike yaron amintacce duk da haka cikin kwanciyar hankali, ko dai a kan cinya, bisa kafada, ko, idan jariri, ya kwanta a bayansu.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_003: Yana da mahimmanci a gare su su ji lafiya. Yara ƙanana na iya zama marasa natsuwa kuma suna iya buƙatar swaddled.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_004: Yin nazarin jim kaɗan bayan ciyarwa zai iya taimakawa saboda za su kasance cikin annashuwa da ɗan barci.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_005: Manya yara za su iya daidaitawa ta yin wasa da abin wasan yara na ɗan lokaci kaɗan.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_006: Yi magana da sautin abokantaka kuma kuyi ƙoƙarin sauka zuwa matakin idanunsu.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_007: Bayyana abin da za ku yi kuma ku sami izini kafin ku fara.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_008: Na farko, tambayi mahaifiya ko mai kula da su idan sun ga wani abu da ba daidai ba a ido ko hangen nesa da kuma tsawon lokacin da suka lura da matsalar.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_009: Na gaba, dubi fuskar yaron da idanunsa. Tambayi kanka wasu tambayoyi.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_010: Shin yaron yana da alama yana jin zafi a ido ɗaya ko duka biyu? Idanun a bude suke ko kuwa sun rufe su sosai?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_011: Akwai shayarwa ko fitarwa daga idanu? Girman idanu iri ɗaya ne? Shin gashin ido sun kumbura?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_012: Yanzu, la'akari da yadda yaron yake gani. Matsar da fuskarka a hankali daga gefe zuwa gefe, kallon idanunsu.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_013: Yi murmushi shiru. Shin yaron yana bin motsin fuskar ku ko amsa murmushin ku na shiru?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_014: Kuma, tambayi kanku wasu tambayoyi. Shin idanu biyu suna motsawa cikin 'yanci kuma tare?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_015: Idanun sun mike ne ko ido daya yana juyawa ciki ko waje? Idanun sun yi rawar jiki?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_016: Hakanan zaka iya amfani da hasken wuta akan Arclight da maƙasudin hoto don samun hankali da tantance ingancin hangen nesa.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_017: Matsar da maƙasudin gefe zuwa gefe, sama da ƙasa. Duba don ganin ko yaron yana gyarawa kuma yana bin abin da aka sa a gaba.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_018: Shin za su iya isa su nuna daidai a wurin da aka nufa?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_019: Sau da yawa, ido ɗaya kawai ba ya iya gani da kyau. Kai ko uwa za ku iya rufe ido ɗaya, sannan ɗayan.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_020: Matsar da abin da ake nufi da kwatanta yadda yaron ya kasance lokacin amfani da idanu biyu, sannan daya bayan daya.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_021: Idan yaron ba ya son a rufe ido ɗaya, yana nuna cewa idon da ba a rufe ba ya gani sosai.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_022: Idan kuna tunanin za ku iya ganin wani abu ba daidai ba tare da ido na waje, duba da kyau ta amfani da ƙarshen loupe na Arclight.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_023: Kunna fitilun kuma matsa sama kusa da kusan 6 cm. Kuna iya buƙatar amfani da yatsa don buɗe idanun ido a hankali.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_024: Tambayi kanka wasu tambayoyi. Farin bangaren ido ruwan hoda ne ko ja? Shin almajiri ko cornea launin toka ne ko fari?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_025: Almajiri zagaye ne? Kuna iya ganin wani jikin waje? Yanzu kun shirya don yin gwaje-gwajen reflex.

mumVisionPage.cue_001: A cikin mahaifa, jaririn da ke cikin ciki yana kewaye da sauti masu laushi da kwantar da hankali, ciki har da nasu
mumVisionPage.cue_002: bugun zuciya na uwa da tsarin narkewar abinci da muryoyi da sauti daga duniyar waje. Kamar yadda
mumVisionPage.cue_003: ciki ya kai matakin ƙarshe, idanuwan jariri na iya buɗewa a cikin mahaifar. Alhali ba za su iya ba
mumVisionPage.cue_004: duk da haka ganin hotuna ko cikakkun bayanai, suna iya fahimtar canje-canje a cikin haske. Don haka, yayin da rayuwa a cikin mahaifa ta kasance cikin ruɗe
mumVisionPage.cue_005: kuma dim, yayi nisa da shiru. Haihuwa babban canji ne ga jariri. Nan take suka shiga
mumVisionPage.cue_006: duniya mai cike da sabbin abubuwa masu haske da ƙarar sauti. Daidaita zuwa wannan sabuwar duniya abin ji ne
mumVisionPage.cue_007: farkawa da suka fara ci gaban su. A cikin makonni na farko na rayuwa, jariri zai
mumVisionPage.cue_008: firgita da farkawa idan akwai kararraki. Idanunsu suna jin haske ga fitilu masu haske.
mumVisionPage.cue_009: amma har yanzu suna iya gani kadan. Ganinsu shine, duk da haka, yana fara haɓakawa a cikin ban mamaki
mumVisionPage.cue_010: ƙimar. A cikin makonni biyu, hangen nesa ya inganta sosai. Yanzu suna iya ganin wasu cikakkun bayanai, musamman
mumVisionPage.cue_011: idan abubuwa sun kusa. Babu kala, kuma abin da suke gani lebur ne saboda idanunsu
mumVisionPage.cue_012: har yanzu ba su kasance madaidaiciya ba kuma suna aiki tare don zurfin fahimta. Wani lokaci idanunsu
mumVisionPage.cue_013: zai shige ko fita na ɗan lokaci kaɗan. Ana kiran wannan squinting. Wannan ya kamata a daina faruwa
mumVisionPage.cue_014: da wata uku. A wata daya, hangen nesa na launi yana farawa. Za su yi yawa
mumVisionPage.cue_015: mafi sha'awar gani, musamman ga fuska. Za su kuma fara ƙoƙarin bin abubuwa
mumVisionPage.cue_016: masu motsi. Za su ƙara fahimtar sautunan da aka sani, gami da sanannun
mumVisionPage.cue_017: muryoyin, kamar danginsu, kuma su fara haɗa abin da suka ji da abin da suke
mumVisionPage.cue_018: gani. Bayan wata uku, idanunsu ya kamata su kasance madaidaiciya kuma suyi aiki tare don ƙirƙirar
mumVisionPage.cue_019: 3D hangen nesa. Wannan sabon fahimtar zurfin fahimta yana taimaka musu isa ga abubuwa daidai. Su
mumVisionPage.cue_020: za su iya bin abubuwan da ke tafiya da sauri. A lokaci guda, sauti masu ma'ana
mumVisionPage.cue_021: za a fara yi. Da wata shida, jariri ya kamata ya iya gane mutanen da suka saba
mumVisionPage.cue_022: ta fuskarsu da muryoyinsu. Hakanan za su iya fara ganin abubuwan da ke gaba
mumVisionPage.cue_023: nesa. Ƙaunar son sani, za su kai ga abubuwa, su yi rarrafe zuwa gare su, kuma, a kusa da su
mumVisionPage.cue_024: ranar haihuwarsu ta farko, tafiya. Babblings suna tasowa kuma sauti zai zama na farko
mumVisionPage.cue_025: kalmomi a wannan mataki kuma. Da watanni 18, hangen nesa yana kama da manya, kodayake har yanzu
mumVisionPage.cue_026: a bit blur. Yanzu za su iya gane sunansu kuma suna ƙara amfani da kalmomi.
mumVisionPage.cue_027: Wasu jariran ƙila ba za su iya cimma waɗannan matakan ci gaba a lokacin da ake tsammani ba. Akwai
mumVisionPage.cue_028: dalilai da yawa na wannan, kuma da yawa za su gyara kansu. Misali, jariran da ba su kai ba
mumVisionPage.cue_029: na iya samun jinkiri, amma yawanci yakan kama daga baya a cikin yara. Ga wasu, ana iya samun nacewa
mumVisionPage.cue_030: matsaloli. Gano waɗannan da wuri-wuri don ba da magani da tallafi zai iya

usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_001: Wannan bidiyon yana bayanin yadda ake amfani da Arclight don aiwatar da jajayen reflex ta hanyar zaɓar saitin haske mafi haske.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_002: Tabbatar cewa tarin ruwan tabarau yana saman, inda babu ikon ruwan tabarau a cikin rami na gani.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_003: A tsayin hannu, lura da reflex a idanu biyu a lokaci guda.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_004: Kwatanta haske da launi tsakanin idanu biyu.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_005: A cikin gwajin al'ada, bai kamata a sami bambanci gaba ɗaya a cikin haske da launi tsakanin idanu biyu ba.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_006: A cikin fararen fata da jarirai na Asiya, reflex na iya yin kama da orange da rawaya.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_007: Har yanzu waɗannan bayyanuwa duk na al'ada ne saboda gaba ɗaya launi da haske iri ɗaya ne tsakanin idanuwa biyu.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_008: Matsala mara kyau ita ce lokacin da aka sami tsayin daka, ainihin bambanci a cikin haske da launi tsakanin idanu biyu.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_009: Wannan na iya zama hangen nesa na kusurwoyi da aka kora, duhun facin da ke cikin reflex na ido ɗaya ko idanu biyu, ko jajayen rashi gaba ɗaya.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_010: Gwajin reflex mara kyau na iya nuna kasancewar cataract, retinoblastoma, tabo na corneal, squint, ko kuskuren refractive.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_011: Waɗannan duk suna buƙatar ƙarin kimantawa daga ƙwararrun ƙwararru.

usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_001: Wannan bidiyon yana ba da taƙaitaccen gabatarwa ga na'urar Arclight.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_002: Kunna shi ta amfani da wannan maɓallin launin toka.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_003: Da farko, duka ƙarshen Arclight na iya zuwa a lokaci guda.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_004: Idan bai kunna kwata-kwata ko fitulun ba su da ƙarfi, baturin na iya zama a kwance.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_005: Toshe shi ta amfani da cajar USB.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_006: Lokacin caji, fitilolin kore zasu kunna.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_007: Bayan minti 15, ya kamata a caje shi sosai kuma yayi aiki na sa'o'i da yawa.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_008: Barin shi a cikin hasken rana zai ci gaba da cajin baturi.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_009: Ba za ku buƙaci maye gurbin kowane baturi ko kwararan fitila ba.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_010: Yanayin lokacin da ƙarshen duka suka zo don amfanin gaba ɗaya ne.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_011: Canja zuwa yanayin ido ta hanyar riƙe maɓallin ƙasa na daƙiƙa 15.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_012: Sa'an nan kuma ɗaga yatsanka kuma da sauri sake danna yayin da hasken ya haskaka.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_013: Yanzu kuna cikin yanayin ido, inda za a kunna ophthalmoscope
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_014: na farko, sa'an nan kuma na gaba part loupe.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_015: Maimaita waɗannan matakan zai sake zagayowar ta hanyoyi daban-daban na amfani guda uku.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_016: Amfani na gaba ɗaya, idanu, sannan kunnuwa.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_017: Da zarar ka zaɓi yanayin da aka fi so, danna maɓallin launin toka
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_018: yana canza yadda fitulun ke haskakawa da kuma wane ƙarshen ke haskakawa.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_019: Tabbatar cewa kayi amfani da madaidaicin ƙarshen don gwajin daidai.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_020: Ana bincika ido na waje ta amfani da loupe.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_021: Ra'ayin zai bayyana lokacin da kake kusa da ido a kusa da 6 cm.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_022: Ana yin reflex na kuɗi a tsawon hannu ta amfani da ophthalmoscope kai tsaye.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_023: Idan ra'ayi ya ɓaci, to duba akwatin ruwan tabarau yana saman.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_024: A cikin wannan matsayi, babu ruwan tabarau a cikin rami na gani kuma reflex ya kamata ya bayyana.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_025: Hakanan ana iya amfani da Arclight don ɗaukar bidiyo na alamun asibiti
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_026: lokacin da aka haɗe zuwa kyamarar wayar hannu.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_027: Da zarar an haɗa, ramin gani na kai tsaye ophthalmoscope
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_028: za a sanya shi kai tsaye a tsakiyar ruwan tabarau wanda kyamarar tafi da gidanka ke amfani da ita a yanayin bidiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_029: Kamara za ta yi aiki kamar idanuwan ku lokacin da kuke duba ta cikin rami na gani.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_030: Don tabbatar da wane ruwan tabarau don daidaita ramin gani da shi,
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_031: bude aikace-aikacen bidiyo akan wayarka, sanya yatsanka akan kowane ruwan tabarau bi da bi.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_032: Lokacin da allon yayi duhu, kun rufe ruwan tabarau da aka yi amfani da shi don bidiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_033: Cire takardar rawaya daga bayan shirin.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_034: Sanya wuraren kibiya akan tsakiyar ruwan tabarau da ake amfani da su don ɗaukar bidiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_037: Ya kamata shirin yanzu ya kasance a daidai matsayi.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_038: Don bidiyo da reflex, kunna kai tsaye ophthalmoscope
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_039: ƙarshen Arclight kuma zaɓi haske mafi haske tare da dannawa uku.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_040: Tabbatar cewa akwatin ruwan tabarau yana saman.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_041: Tare da hasken yana fuskantar nesa daga wayar zuwa ga majiyyaci.

usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_001: Wannan bidiyon yana bayyana yanayin al'ada da rashin daidaituwa na jajayen bayyanar.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_002: Gwajin jajayen reflex na al'ada na al'ada shine lokacin da babu bambanci gaba ɗaya a cikin haske da launi tsakanin idanu biyu tare da hangen nesa na tsakiya.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_003: Ko da bayyanar al'ada na reflex na asusun zai bambanta, ko da yake, ya bambanta dangane da nisan da kuke da kuma inda yaron yake kallo.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_004: Yana da wani aiki mai ƙarfi jarrabawa inda ya kamata ka matsa gefe zuwa gefe da baya da baya a ciki da kuma kewaye da tsawon hannu daga majiyyaci.

usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_008: Matsala mara kyau ita ce lokacin da aka sami tsayin daka, ainihin bambanci a cikin haske da launi tsakanin idanu biyu.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_009: Nunin yanayin da aka yi gudun hijira, duhun facin da ke akwai a cikin reflex na ido ɗaya ko idanu biyu, ko jajayen rashi gaba ɗaya.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_010: Gwajin reflex mara kyau zai iya nuna kasancewar cataract, retinoblastoma, tabo na corneal, squint, kuskuren refractive ko matsalolin haihuwa kamar coloboma.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_011: Waɗannan duk suna buƙatar ƙarin kimantawa daga ƙwararrun ƙwararru.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_012: Dubi wannan reflex kuma ku tambayi kanku: shin wannan al'ada ce ko kuma ba ta da kyau? Amsoshin zasu biyo baya.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_013: Ya kamata a yanzu ku sami kyakkyawar fahimta game da yadda yanayin reflex na yau da kullun yake kama, da kuma abubuwan da ba na al'ada ba, kuma ku iya ba da shawarar mafi yuwuwar sanadin.

questions.prompt: An rubuta hangen nesa na mara lafiya a matsayin NPL a idon dama da 6/6 a idon hagu. Wane rukunin nakasar gani za su dace da shi?
options: Mara lafiya da tsananin nakasar gani (SSI)
questions.explanation: Rukunan nakasar gani sun danganta da ganin ido biyu. Ko da wani ya zama 'mara gani' a idonsa daya, idan yana da gani na al'ada a dayan idon, ana bayyana shi a matsayin yana da gani na al'ada.

questions.prompt: Wane fasaha ake amfani da shi don gwada RAPD?
questions.explanation: Akwai hanyoyi uku don gwada martanin hasken dalili: kai tsaye, ta hanyar kallon dalilin da haske yake haskawa; marar kai tsaye ko hadin gwiwa, ta hanyar lura da dalilin abokin; da gwajin haske mai swinging, ta lura da dalilin yayin da haske yake isa don duba RAPD.

options: Rashin Lafiya na Pupilla da ya shafi 'Relatively Affective'
Rashin Lafiya na Pupilla da ya shafi 'Relative Afferent'
Rashin Lafiya na Pupilla da ya shafi 'Relative Affective'
questions.explanation: Ana gwada RAPD ta hanyar gwajin hasken motsi. Wannan yana ba mai gwaji damar kwatanta tsarin afere na idanu biyu yayin da yake duba daya daga cikin idanu, wanda yake zama hanyar da ta dace don gano ko tsarin afere guda daya ya lalace idan aka kwatanta da dayan.

questions.prompt: Wane alamar asibiti ake gani a RAPD?
options: Rashin kyau na takurawa na pupilla yayin da aka haskaka shi
Fadadawa na pupilla yayin da aka haskaka shi
Babu takurawa lokacin da aka haskaka shi
Fadadawa na pupilla yayin da aka haskaka dayan idon
questions.explanation: Dalilin ido yawanci yana ƙuncin lokacin da haske ya haska shi. A yayin gwajin haske mai motsi, faɗaɗa ba a tsammani lokacin da haske ya kai ido yana nuna cewa akwai RAPD a wannan gefen.

questions.prompt: Lokacin da muke gwadawa don RAPD, wane sassan hanyar gani muke tantancewa?
options: Lobe na occipital (cibiyar gani) na kwakwalwa
Hanyoyin gani daga tsakiyar kwakwalwa zuwa lobe na occipital
questions.explanation: Retina da jijiyar ido suna ƙirƙirar sassan gaba na tsarin shigarwa, suna ɗaukar bayanai daga ido zuwa tsakiyar kwakwalwa don fara aikin motsa ko amsar fita wanda ke canza girman dalilin ido.

questions.prompt: Menene zai iya haifar da RAPD?
options: Cikin Ciwon Jijiyar Jini ta Ruwan Gwagwarmaya
questions.explanation: Duk wani ciwon ido ko jijiyar gani da ke shafar aikin shiga na iya haifar da RAPD, ciki har da wani lamari na jijiyar jini da ke shafar ruwan ido.

questions.prompt: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan shine babban manufar gwajin hasken jan ƙasa na ido a jariri da aka haifa?
options: Gano ciwon da ke toshe hanyar gani
questions.explanation: A jariri da aka haifa, babban manufar shine gane ciwon da ke toshe haske daga shigowa ido. Wannan na iya haɗawa da ciwon kornea, lens, vitreous, retina ko jijiyar gani.

questions.prompt: Jariri mai wata 3 yana da hasken jan ido mai haske a ido na hagu amma haske mai rauni a ido na dama. Menene mafi dacewa a yi?
options: Shiryawa gaggawar tura zuwa kwararren ido
Shiryawa tura na yau da kullum zuwa kwararren ido
questions.explanation: Duk wani abin da bai dace ba a wannan gwajin yana bukatar a duba shi gaggawa daga kwararren ido saboda cuta mai tsanani, kamar cataract ko retinoblastoma, na iya kasancewa.

questions.prompt: Jariri mai wata 9 da aka haifa a mako na 36 na juna biyu yana nuna ci gaban hangen nesa mara kyau da rashin hasken ido a duka idanunsa. Menene mafi yiyuwar sanadin wadannan abubuwan?
options: Bugun jini a gindin kwakwalwa (Occipital lobe stroke)
questions.explanation: Rashin dawo da hasken fundal yana faruwa ne saboda wani abu da ke toshe haske daga shiga ido. Retinopathy of Prematurity na iya haifar da rushewar retina, amma yafi faruwa a jarirai da aka haifa kafin makonni 34. Retinoblastoma na iya haifar da rasa wannan haske amma abin yana da ban mamaki sosai, yana faruwa a kusan 1 cikin haihuwa 15,000. Cataract shine mafi yawan sanadin a jarirai da kananan yara, yana faruwa a kusan 1 cikin haihuwa 1,000 zuwa 2,000.

questions.prompt: Wanne daga cikin wadannan yanayi a babban mutum ne mafi kankanin yiwuwa ya haifar da rashin daidaiton hasken fundal 'ja'?
options: Ciwon jini a jikin ido (Vitreous Haemorrhage)
Bugun jini a gindin kwakwalwa (Occipital lobe stroke)
questions.explanation: Stroke a lobe na Occipital ba shi da yuwuwa sosai. Ko da yake yana haifar da rashin gani, wannan yana faruwa ne sakamakon lalacewar kwakwalwa ba cuta da ke shafar bayyana kayan ido ba.

questions.prompt: Wadanne gine-gine, kuma a wane tsari, haske ke wucewa ta ciki don haskaka fundus da haifar da inuwa mai launin ja a fundus?
questions.explanation: Haske yana wucewa ta cornea, lens da vitreous zuwa retina, wani bayyananne membrane dake rufe choroid na fundus inda haske yake dawowa. Cutar cornea, lens, vitreous, retina ko choroid na iya haifar da sakamakon gwajin refleksi na fundal mara kyau.
